design_condition: The building is set parallel to and slightly overlapping the existing hall, pulled away from the southern and eastern boundaries to create usable outdoor space and a more tolerable transition to neighboring properties.

positive.statement: Moving the building away from the boundaries creates usable outdoor spaces and a well-tolerated integration into the existing development.

position.rationale: Open space is concentrated along the southern and eastern building edges, visible in plan and lower elevations.

positive.statement: The transition between the neighbors' private environment and public use has been successful.

position.target: transition between private and public environments
position.rationale: The approximate transition zone follows the exposed eastern edge between building mass and neighboring context.

positive.statement: The large forecourt offers a high quality of stay and allows a wide variety of uses and events.

position.rationale: A broad open forecourt is legible along the southern side of the rectilinear volume.

positive.statement: The strict surrounding facade grid is distinctive.

position.rationale: Repeated aligned point rows clearly define the exterior facade grid on multiple elevations.

positive.statement: Separating vehicle and pedestrian access clarifies the situation.

position.rationale: Access is anchored approximately at the southern forecourt edge, where external circulation meets the building.

positive.statement: The selection of native trees, tall perennials and seeds is successful from both a design and ecological perspective.

position.rationale: Landscape planting is approximated along the open eastern site margin; individual vegetation is not distinguishable.

positive.statement: The structuralist organization creates a very clear spatial division with patios and spaces in between.

position.rationale: Several internal breaks and patio-like voids visibly organize the parallel building strips.

positive.statement: Playing with spatial sequences creates interesting situations.

position.rationale: Sequential passages and alternating open intervals are readable through the layered plan arrangement.

positive.statement: The material meets the client's requirements and the economic indicators are average.

position.rationale: Material performance is assigned broadly to the visible building envelope; economic judgment has no precise location.

negative.statement: Playing fields and lounge areas along the border cause certain noise emissions.

position.target: playing fields and lounge areas along the border
position.rationale: Border activity is approximated along the southern and eastern open-space edge.

negative.statement: Abolishing the existing parking spaces unreasonably worsens access to the existing sports hall in terms of safety and clarity.

position.rationale: Parking impact is assigned to the forecourt-side external zone, without distinct parking geometry.

negative.statement: The pavement at the main entrance and bicycle parking spaces is unsuitable functionally and in terms of maintenance.

position.rationale: The entrance-related hardscape is approximated at the southern approach edge.

negative.statement: The access around the northwest corner is narrow and confusing.

position.rationale: The northwest perimeter corner is directly constrained by plan position and the north elevation.

negative.statement: The corridors in front of the cloakrooms are too small for school operations.

position.target: corridors in front of the cloakrooms
position.rationale: Interior corridor space is approximated within the lower-middle building strip, absent as a distinct exterior feature.

negative.statement: The connection to the existing sports hall is unsuitable because the aisles are too narrow for larger sports equipment.

position.target: connection to the existing sports hall
position.rationale: The likely connection is placed at the overlapping northwestern side of the sampled mass.

negative.statement: The static system with storey-high wooden Vierendeel beams is assessed as unfeasible.

position.rationale: Structural beams are approximated on the exposed facade grid where repeated elevation rows are visible.

negative.statement: Playing with spatial sequences comes at the expense of flexibility.

position.rationale: The flexibility criticism concerns the building's overall organizational strategy rather than one identifiable location.

negative.statement: The operational organization in the sports sector would have to be greatly optimized.

position.rationale: Operations are assigned broadly to the central sports-hall zone, with no separate operational geometry.

negative.statement: The main deficiencies lie in the proposed supporting structure and the final details presented.

position.rationale: The criticism applies broadly to the sampled structural envelope and unresolved detailing.
